events.comment:
FRACTION PIZZA PANIC - Level 1 "First Shift" (GDD v2.0, Sec. 2.11)
Mouse only: 1) click a pan = DENOMINATOR (total slices), 2) pick a topping and click slices = NUMERATOR,
3) SERVE. Step: 0 = next customer arrives, 1 = building the pizza, 2 = customer reacts.
Orders are listed in group 0. Mode 0 = exact pan required, 1 = any equivalent fraction, 2 = Fair Split.
Global: OrderIndex, Score, Tips, Rating (starts 100, -20 per failed order), CorrectCount, Won.

events.name: 0. Next customer arrives (the Level 1 order queue)

events.comment: Orders 1-2: untimed tutorial. 3-5: timed halves/quarters. 6: equivalence (4/8). 7: multi-topping. 8: Fair Split closer. Edit the fractions and lines here.
